name: TROPICAL_FOURIER_ANALYSIS

primitives.name: TropicalPolynomial
primitives.description: A function defined over a tropical semiring (max-plus or min-plus) with computable coefficients.

primitives.name: TropicalFourierTransform
primitives.description: A mapping from tropical polynomials to their Fourier coefficients over a tropical semiring.

primitives.name: DiscrepancyMeasure
primitives.description: A function quantifying the deviation of a tropical polynomial from uniformity.

operations.name: TropicalConvolution
operations.description: Combines two tropical polynomials via tropical addition and multiplication.

operations.name: FourierTransform
operations.description: Computes the Fourier coefficients of a tropical polynomial.

operations.name: DiscrepancyCalculation
operations.description: Evaluates the discrepancy measure for a given tropical polynomial.

target_invariant.name: MinimalFourierCoefficient
target_invariant.what_it_should_bound: The discrepancy of a function under tropical Fourier analysis.

axioms_tentative: A1: TropicalConvolution preserves the tropical semiring structure under composition.
A2: TropicalFourierTransform is invertible when restricted to certain tropical polynomials.
A3: DiscrepancyMeasure is bounded by the maximum absolute value of Fourier coefficients.
